note: Organisations Vithean works with. Every entry here is evidenced by something that actually happened — a signed agreement, a shipped integration, or an event on the record. Do not add a logo because a conversation took place.

kinds.partner: A signed or standing working relationship.
kinds.integration: A platform Vithean connects to. NOT an endorsement of Vithean, and must never be presented as one.
kinds.community: An event, forum or programme Vithean took part in. Participation, not partnership.

rules.logo: null until the artwork has been obtained from the organisation. The section renders a wordmark instead, so a missing file is never a broken image.
rules.display: false keeps an entry in the file but off the page. Integrations render under their own heading so a technical connection is never presented as an endorsement.
rules.artwork: Use the file the organisation supplies. Do not redraw, recolour or crop a logo — the same rule the acquiring bank sets for the payment marks in company.json.
rules.maker: POSCAR Digital Co., Ltd. is the maker of Vithean and is NOT listed here. A partner list is for other organisations; the company that builds the product belongs in company.json `maker`.
